settled_findings: CC-6: minor — Decision 4 and Decision 5 already specify storing '' for undefined top-level tool_call input, and '' vs absent yields identical argsSummary at turn_end.
CC-7 / critic-r1-CR-S3-6: minor — accepted diagnostic limitation under M11 that an all-dropped settlement writes no taiknr-side-store entry; counters/status belong to the Status card.
critic-r1-CR-S3-2: minor — M7 settled last-match toolCallId pairing through contextEntries over positional indexing.

resolutions.rationale: Verified against Pi 1.5.2 source: unlike `emitBoundary` and `emit`, `ExtensionRunner.emitToolCall` (`runner.js:965-979`) has no `try/catch`, `_beforeToolCall` (`agent-session.js:386-401`) rethrows, and `prepareToolCall` (`agent-loop.js:487-544`) turns a `tool_call` throw into `createErrorToolResult`, blocking the user's tool execution. Because `event.input` is mutable by earlier `tool_call` handlers (`types.d.ts:1005`), bare `JSON.stringify(event.input)` throwing on a `BigInt`, circular reference, or throwing `toJSON` breaks user tool calls and makes Decision 11's claim that throws go to the extension error channel false for `tool_call`. Not churn: bare `JSON.stringify(event.input)` was already in Decision 4 prior to Stage 2.
resolutions.required_change:
1. In `design.md` Decision 4 (and Decision 5), specify that `tool-call.ts` wraps `JSON.stringify(event.input)` in a `try/catch` that falls back to `""` on any serialization throw (`BigInt`, circular reference, throwing `toJSON`) before passing the result (or `""` for `undefined`) to `summarizeSingleLine(..., 120)`.
2. In `design.md` Decision 11, separate `tool_call` from the other five handlers: in Pi 1.5.2 `ExtensionRunner.emitToolCall` (`runner.js:965-979`) and `prepareToolCall` (`agent-loop.js:487-544`) turn a `tool_call` throw into a blocked error tool result rather than an extension-channel report, so `tool_call` is total and never throws on any input; unexpected throws in `turn_end`, `agent_before_settle`, `session_start`, `session_tree`, and `session_compact` propagate to Pi's extension error channel without partial state mutation.
3. In `design.md` Module & File Placement (`tests/infra/pi-event-handlers/tool-call.test.ts` row), widen the `undefined` case to cover `undefined`, `BigInt`, and circular `event.input` values recording `""` without throwing.

resolutions.rationale: Minor finding on an already-settled council ruling (`M7`): `contextEntries` last-match pairing by `toolCallId` was deliberately chosen over positional indexing because `toolResultEntryIds` is `flatMap`-filtered, and duplicate `toolCallId`s within a single turn violate provider tool-call protocols. Recorded without blocking convergence.

[]` keeps isolated text-only unit calls to `toSettlementDrafts` total.

Minor test-mechanics detail belonging to `tasks.md` (Stage 5) rather than `design.md` (`zoom-out-standard.md` §4): `specs/archive-stubbing/spec.md` ('Abort, then settle' and 'A branch switch after an abort') already requires staging an item before the abort so the carry-forward and drop paths are non-vacuous.
Minor prose elaboration on a trade-off `M4` and `specs/archive-stubbing/spec.md` ('A boundary Pi discards') already accepted and documented.

Minor diagnostic prose nit (same point settled in Stage 2 `CC-7`): under `M11` there is no logger or drop counter before the Status card, and an all-dropped settlement intentionally writes no `taiknr-side-store` entry.

Minor table-phrasing nit: `D7` locks `stageToolOutputs(input: StageToolOutputsInput): ArchivedToolOutput[]` at `HEAD`, and `tasks.md` (Stage 5) verifies every signature against disk. Not promoted above its reported minor severity.
Minor nit: `turn_end` only stages into `pendingOutputs` and `originalContentByEntryId` and proposes no boundary drafts (Decision 1), so returning `undefined` is already implied.
